title: A tiny story
summary: Numbers arrive, get checked, stored and explained.

steps.title: A file arrives
steps.caption: Every system sends a results file every minute.
steps.engineering: File lands in object storage; an event triggers processing.
steps.presenterNote: Everything starts with a plain file. Nothing fancy.

steps.title: We check it
steps.caption: Wrong or missing numbers are stopped before anyone sees them.
steps.engineering: Schema and range validation; bad files are quarantined with a reason.
steps.presenterNote: Bad numbers never reach a person.

steps.title: We explain it
steps.caption: One short report every morning.
steps.engineering: Numbers computed in SQL; the model writes only the sentence.
steps.presenterNote: The AI writes words, never numbers.
